etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English contribucioun, contribucion, from Old French contribution, from Latin contribūtiōnem, contribūtiō, from Latin contribuēre. By surface analysis, contribute +‎ -ion.

definitions.definition: Something given or offered that adds to a larger whole.
An amount of money given toward something.
The taking part, often with the idea that it has led to (scientific etc.) progress.
